snippet.title: [KDFW] - Dallas Fort Worth Intl. Airport Trailer by FeelThere for Tower! Simulator
snippet.description:
Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (KDFW) is one of the largest and busiest airports in the world, located between Dallas and Fort Worth, Texas. It serves as a major hub for American Airlines and offers extensive domestic and international connections. The airport covers about 27 square miles, has five terminals (A-E), and seven runways, making it one of the most expansive airports in the United States. Its central U.S. location makes it a key gateway for transcontinental and global travel.

FEATURES:
– Realistic modeling with over 50 custom modelled buildings.
– Detailed ground polygon model.
– Taxi signs and 3D taxi lights around the airport that follow the curvature of the line.
– Runway approach lighting.
– Beautiful background scenery and city using OSM (Open Street Map).
– Realistic radar display.
